pieces.Text: As a full-round action, a frost worm can emit a strange trilling sound that affects all creatures within a 100-foot radius.  Creatures must succeed on a DC

Will save or be fascinated for as long as the worm continues to trill (the frost worm can maintain this trill by concentrating).  Once a creature has resisted or broken the effect, it cannot be affected again by that same frost worm's trill for 24 hours.  This is a sonic mind-affecting effect.
